description: Transvaalbuurt 1930 portiek blocks of Albert Luthulistraat 6-32, the tower pand: a dark red-brown brick front of a 4.1 m ground storey and three 3.1 m upper storeys under a 0.75 m plain parapet with a light coping (top 14.25 m), white two-light casement windows with a top light in pairs (a single window at one end), and over the portiek a 5.7-6.3 m broad brick stair tower rising about 3 m over the coping to a flat top, one wide light near its top; in the tower each storey has a narrow two-light window either side of the stair axis, whose narrow stair lights climb between ochre header-brick ladders; a grey concrete canopy over the tower's ground storey. Its sibling transvaal-1930-stair-block is the 12.6-12.9 m pand between two towers

match.note: Albert Luthulistraat 6-32 (BAG 1930 on all 7 pands; 3DBAG bouwlagen 5, eaves 12.7-14.8 m, roof max 14.7-14.8 m: the setback roof storey, not the towers, which 3DBAG misses). One design of two pand kinds that BAG cuts alternately: 16.2-16.5 m tower pands (and 073273 at 14.3 m) and 12.6-12.9 m stair pands; the frontage width tells them apart (transvaal-1930-stair-tower 13.8-17.2 m, transvaal-1930-stair-block 12.0-13.6 m). The strip evidence gate holds the tower pands (sky over the roof in 57-68 % of columns: the tower stands in the band over the roof), so the luthuli faces are placed by hand from this library (authoring note in the run intent).

tower.note: Albert Luthulistraat 30-32 (124743) and 18-20 (092667): wall top with a light coping 14.0-14.3 m; the tower 6.45-12.25 m (124743) / 6.9-12.6 m (092667) from the pand's left runs past the strip top (16.77 m), its top light 15.1-16.1 m (1.55 m wide, centred); lane #153 read the tower about 3 m over the coping (rise 1.0 upper storeys)

door-centre.note: the portiek door (red, 1.05 m, head 3.4 m) on the stair axis under a grey concrete canopy at 3.85-4.1 m that spans the tower's 5.8 m (drawn over the door only); a ground window either side in the tower, mailboxes

roof.evidence: Albert Luthulistraat 22-32 strip 2020-04-29: a level coping with a white roof-terrace railing of the setback roof storey behind it (14.4-15.3 m); no roof face over the front; 3DBAG roof max 14.7-14.8 m

rhythm.bays: a single window at one end, a window pair, the stair tower (narrow two-light window, stair lights, narrow two-light window), a window pair
rhythm.identicalBays: no: the tower is broad, the single window and the pairs

rhythm.groundFloor: the portiek door on the tower axis under a grey canopy, garden windows
rhythm.roofline: flat; a plain parapet with a light coping, the tower about 3 m over it

the tower's flank windows sit 0.3-0.7 m higher than the main windows; drawn on the main line
the grey canopy spans the tower's whole 5.8 m ground storey; groundCanopy draws it over the door only (overhang <= 0.4 m)
the setback roof storey with its white roof-terrace railing (14.4-15.3 m) is not drawn

the single end window stands at the end BAG gives it; on 30-32 that end is blank wall (the pair moves 3 m in)
